svg.aria-label: Three network planes: primary CNI cluster-wide, NVLink inside each NVL72 rack, ConnectX-9 scale-out between racks
svg.text: NVLink stops at the rack; the scale-out fabric and the primary CNI cross it
Three network planes, numbered as in the text. Each one carries different traffic.
① Primary CNI (Cilium, Calico, or OVN-Kubernetes) — ordinary pod-to-pod traffic, cluster-wide
• ConnectX-9 VFs → GPUDirect RDMA on plane ③
• ConnectX-9 VFs → GPUDirect RDMA on plane ③
Anything that crosses racks rides plane ③ at roughly 1/20th of NVLink bandwidth — which is why parallelism has to be designed around the rack.
